content:
You are an environment designer for a HighwayEnv acceleration-lane merge simulator.
Return one JSON object with exactly two keys: scenario and hypothesis.
scenario fields: name (short string), vehicles (integer 2..18), spacing (18..60 m),
speed_spread (0..7 m/s), merge_length (140..300 m), traffic_speed (16..28 m/s),
ego_speed (16..28 m/s), phase (-15..15 m), rationale (string).
The ego begins at x=40,y=8. Two main lanes are at y=0,4; acceleration lane y=8 ends
at merge_length with an obstacle. Success requires safe travel 30 m beyond the end
in a main lane. Actions: left, idle, right, faster, slower. Main traffic has fixed
lanes, IDM control, and seeded uniform speed variation. All physics is HighwayEnv.
Spacing is centre-to-centre within each main lane; phase translates traffic in x.
No arbitrary Python is accepted. Do not change rewards, success checks or physics.
Use the supplied implementation/document notes and environment memory. Propose a
small, interpretable increase in structural complexity while retaining plausible
gaps. Explain which decision should become harder and why in hypothesis. If a
candidate was rejected, fix the reason. Avoid duplicates. Do not assume complexity
proves difficulty. A fixed controller failing does NOT prove impossibility.
Structural score is mean((vehicles-2)/16,(60-spacing)/42,speed_spread/7,
(300-merge_length)/160). Require an increase of at least 0.015 over last accepted
scenario. The goal is sequential interactive decision-making, not a static quiz.
This is an assignment-specific adaptation inspired by SPADE Appendix C.1, not its
verbatim prompt and not its joint RL training algorithm.

{"memory": [{"round": 0, "attempt": 0, "accepted": true, "mode": "llm", "scenario": {"name": "balanced_initial_merge", "vehicles": 6, "spacing": 38, "speed_spread": 2.0, "merge_length": 220, "traffic_speed": 22, "ego_speed": 20, "phase": 0, "rationale": "Initial baseline establishing a moderate-density merge scenario with 38m inter-vehicle spacing and moderate speed differential."}, "hypothesis": "The ego vehicle starts slightly slower than mainline traffic (20 m/s vs 22 m/s) with a 220m merge length, requiring it to decide whether to accelerate into an opening ahead or yield and merge behind the adjacent mainline vehicle before ramp termination.", "complexity": 0.3899, "evaluation": {"rule": {"success": 0.875, "crashed": 0.125, "offroad": 0.0, "seconds": 10.875, "return": 0.5425, "n": 8}, "random": {"success": 0.125, "crashed": 0.875, "offroad": 0.0, "seconds": 3.875, "return": -0.8175, "n": 8}}}], "round": 1, "note": "Only design seeds 0..7 are used for feedback; held-out 100..119 are unseen."}
